newsitem.title: UK: Tesco says like-for-like sales up 5.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Tesco says like-for-like sales up 5.1 pct.

text.p: British supermarket group Tesco Plc said same store sales in the first 14 weeks of its current financialy year were up 5.1 percent with inflation falling to just 0.3 percent.
In a statement to the annual meeting, Tesco chairman Lord MacLaurin of Knebworth said total UK sales in the period were up nine percent.
The gain in like-for-like sales represents a slowdown from the six percent increase seen in the first four weeks reported with annual results in April.

MacLaurin said the sales rise represented "a good start to the year, coming after two years of continuous strong sales performance, tough comparisons and the lowest level of inflation the industry has seen for a number of years."
He added that "sharply" falling inflation in food prices was "a challenge to all food retailers."
MacLaurin said Tesco was "containing the effects" of lower inflation "through our continued efforts to grow volumes and improve productivity."
